## Theming: What's the point?

Build an especially hideous tile-based monster from mismatched body parts. The precise victory and scoring rules should be taken from the boxed rulebook.

### Source status

This page is deliberately a source limitation notice, not a substitute teach. The physical edition is the appropriate authority until an official publisher or designer rules source becomes available.

## Setting up: How to get started?

No official online rulebook was found to verify setup. Use the setup instructions supplied with the physical edition rather than treating older notes on this site as confirmed rules.

### Before teaching

Have the physical rulebook available. Verify the component list, player count, setup diagram, and any edition-specific changes directly from it.

## Rounds and Phases

No official online rulebook or publisher ruling was found to confirm the turn sequence. Do not rely on partial online summaries for draw, placement, stealing, or discard rules.

### What is intentionally omitted

This page does not specify an action order, tile-placement restriction, die result, hand limit, or exception because none could be checked against an official online source.

## Scoring

No official online source was found to confirm awards, tie-breaks, or end-game scoring. Consult the boxed rulebook.

### Endgame caution

Do not infer an end trigger from a third-party summary. Read the printed end condition and scoring examples before starting a game.

## Terminology

Terms seen in unverified descriptions include **Body Part**, **Torso**, **Buffet**, **Bolt**, **Award**, **Grand Prize**, and **Loose End**. Their rules meanings need confirmation from the physical rulebook.

### Unverified vocabulary

These words are included only to help identify components in the box. They are not definitions and should not be used to resolve a rules question.

## Official rules

No official publisher/designer rulebook, PDF, FAQ, or ruling source was found during research.
